sig: [[["A", "In business news today, Seattle-based software company Cloudvane has announced plans to open its first Asian office in Ho Chi Minh City."], ["A", "The office, which will be located in the city's new technology park, is scheduled to open in September."], ["A", "Cloudvane says it will hire around three hundred engineers there by the end of next year, and that number could double by 2028."], ["A", "The company had originally considered Singapore and Bangkok, but chose Vietnam because of its large pool of young software developers."], ["A", "Chief executive Laura Bennett said the move would allow the company to provide round-the-clock support to customers in different time zones."], ["A", "However, not everyone is convinced."], ["A", "Some analysts point out that competition for experienced engineers in the region is already intense."], ["A", "Salaries for senior developers have risen by nearly twenty percent over the past two years."], ["A", "Still, Cloudvane's shares rose four percent after the announcement."], ["A", "The company plans to hold a recruitment event in the city in July, ahead of the opening."], ["A", "Ms. Bennett will also meet with local university leaders to discuss internship programs."], ["A", "Coming up after the break, we'll have the latest on the housing market."]], {"A": "M-AU"}]
